reviews.body:
Am unsure how much of a issue this is. In anycase, I left some comments on approach since I think the helper function + tests are probably unnecessary.

This has highlighted how old this dependency is though (from 8 years ago) and that the upstream project seems to be unmaintained https://github.com/colinmarc/hdfs

review_comments.body: I don't think this test is achieving much. Should probably drop it

Wouldn't the solution here just be to return the result of `fw.Close()`? e.g

```go
return fw.Close()
```

Or if we want to guarantee `Close` is always called (regardless of `fw.Write` status) then we should probably remove the write from that scoped if statement and join together `Close` + the write error e.g

```go
		_, err = fw.Write(mBytes)
		return errors.Join(err, fw.Close())
```

comments.body: Thanks, done: dropped the helper and the test, and `WriteBatch` now does `_, err = fw.Write(mBytes)` / `return errors.Join(err, fw.Close())`, so Close is always called and its error is returned. The file is also closed on the `AsBytes` error path (unchanged from the first commit).
